page_note: Page is dominated by substrate cosmology: the Aeons of Light / land of peace, the twelve works of the Half-region tied to the wall of fire, and the systematic teaching about the three Mighty Ones (Mother/Darkness/Fire) and their three garments (Wind/Mother/Fire) cast on the three roads at the founding of the cosmos. The editorial machinery is light and concentrated at the chapter seam (segs 18-20, 26): an ornament heading 'Concerning the Mighty Ones' followed by 'Once again the disciples questioned him' and 'Then the apostle said to them' — pure dialogue frame wrapping a substantive cosmological question. The disciples' question itself (when did the Father of Life pour forth the three, did he eat upon one way or upon the first earth) is substratic — it defines the teaching topic. Heavy lacunae (61% damage) but the cosmological skeleton is clear.
